colorPalette.strategy: Dark, premium-tech baseline with high-contrast cyan accents; avoid purple-on-white, cream-terracotta, or newspaper-like monochrome composition.

display.use: Hero headline, major section headings, CTA lead

body.use: Body paragraphs, feature descriptions, footer content

notes: Do not use Inter, Roboto, Arial, or system default stacks as primary brand fonts.
Maintain generous line-height for Korean and English mixed content.

sections.name: Hero
sections.purpose: Immediate brand authority and value proposition in first viewport.

constraints.brandSignal: Enable Design name or logotype must be visible at hero level.
constraints.firstViewportRule: Use a full-bleed dominant visual; do not place cards, overlays, or stat strips in the first viewport.

contentModel.headline: From idea to validated AI product design, faster and with confidence.

heroSubjectHints: Abstract but structured data-light compositions with depth
Modern product team collaboration in dark studio lighting
Close-up technology textures with cyan/emerald highlights
featureSubjectHints: Whiteboard strategy sessions with mixed-discipline teams

motionNotes: Slow parallax drift on the hero background visual (subtle, under 12px perceived movement).
Staggered fade-and-rise reveal for feature blocks on scroll.
Micro-interaction on primary CTA (soft glow pulse on hover/focus).
compositionRules: Prioritize large visual rhythm and whitespace over dense UI card grids.
Keep contrast AAA-ish for key text against dark surfaces where possible.
Use iconography as support, not as dominant storytelling over photography.
